marketAnalysis.summary:
# Korean Market Analysis – September 10, 2026
**KOSPI at 7033.92** [^KS11] reflects modest positioning as regional sentiment remains measured. **US equities (SPX 7591.7)** [^GSPC] provide a stable anchor, supported by moderate volatility (**VIX 17.84**) [^VIX] and contained inflation (**CPI 3.4%**) [^macro.cpi]. **10Y yields at 4.944%** [^TNX] with **Fed Rate 3.63%** [^macro.fed-rate] signal steady monetary conditions, though **DXY 99.06** [^DX-Y.NYB] indicates a firm dollar that may weigh on Korean exporters. **WTI at 103.93 USD/barrel** [^CL=F] and **Gold at 4358.5 USD/oz** [^GC=F] suggest persistent inflation hedging demand, while **Fear&Greed at 33** [^fear-greed] reflects cautious market psychology.
